title: Shave Ice in Rochester MN - Minnesnowii Shave Ice
description: Minnesnowii Shave Ice is now servicing Rochester, MN and the surrounding areas! If you book it, we will come!
heroTitle: Serving Authentic Hawaiian Style Shave Ice to Rochester, MN!
body: Just like in the Twin Cities, Minnesnowii serves our delicious Shave Ice in Rochester, MN and the surrounding communities!
In forming our company, we combined our love for Hawaii and Minnesota, creating Minnesnowii Shave Ice. Our pride is serving Authentic Hawaiian Style Shave Ice, just like in paradise.
The flavors we offer are imported from Hawaii and we use the best commercial block shavers to finely shave the ice. It is so soft that there is never a crunch from the first bite till the last.
